paper_title: Training and Evaluating with Human Label Variation An Empirical Study
caption: Soft accuracy and graphs for a binary classification problem on a single example where the true and the predicted judgement for the positive class is 0.5 and q respectively.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relationship between the value of 'q' and the accuracy of two models, “soft accuracy” and “PO-JSD”. The x-axis is a linear scale ranging from 0.2 to 0.8, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis is also linear, spanning from 0.4 to 1.0, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.05. A solid blue line represents “soft accuracy”, beginning at a value of approximately 0.62 at q=0.2 and peaking at approximately 0.93 at q=0.55. A dashed orange line represents “PO-JSD”, starting at a value of approximately 0.73 at q=0.2 and reaching a value of approximately 0.86 at q=0.55.
